input_text: Ishaan, who will inherit his father's skyscraper developer business, hides his wealth and starts driving a car for the family of Naira, the girl he is engaged to, because he wants to know if she wants him or his bank balance. Her relatives look down on him as a poor hired hand, and her dad shames him before a room full of visitors. Naira refuses to leave his side and secretly covers the made-up loans he claims to owe. The night of their engagement celebration, her dad's business is going under and a lender dispatches an unknown backer. Ishaan arrives in that backer's seat, announces who he really is to the whole crowd and rescues the company. Her father grovels, while Naira weighs whether she can forgive being deceived.
